Hi Laura — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Pilot scope: 3-month evaluation for the patient-message summarization flow (~20k tokens/day).
- Decision criteria: latency < 300ms p95, accuracy on extractive summaries (target F1 > 0.85), and predictable unit costs.
- Stakeholders we identified: you (product lead), David Park (CFO / economic buyer), procurement, and legal (for MSA/DPA). Security will need the questionnaire filled for data handling.

Action items I have:
1) Share Redwood standard MSA + DPA and get NDA signed to start sharing artifacts.
2) Align on legal redline sequencing — do you want NDA first, then MSA/DPA in parallel, or another order?
3) Confirm expected review turn times from your side so we can set expectations internally.

Laura — could you confirm the procurement and legal contacts and who owns the final sign? Also copying Rafael and Neha from our team who will help with contracting and security.

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks Laura — Rafael here (Customer Success). A couple notes from the Redwood side on sequencing and expectations: 

- We agree NDA first to unblock artifact transfer and deeper technical dive. Redwood legal can accept your standard NDA or execute our Mutual NDA. Turn time on our side for NDA is typically 1 business day if no substantive edits.
- For MSA/DPA: we usually send our standard MSA (attached) with a short guide to common redlines we accept (IP, liability caps, data handling). If Acme wants to propose redlines, we recommend a single consolidated redline set to keep cycles to one review.
- Typical negotiation cadence we see: 7-10 business days for an initial MSA redline pass (customer legal), 3-5 days for Redwood legal to respond depending on complexity. If there are commercial term changes (SOW, pricing), procurement involvement can extend the timeline.

Marissa — our legal point of contact on Redwood is legal@redwood.com; for faster routing you can copy me and Neha and I'll help prioritize.

Next step suggestion: Marissa to return Redwood MSA + DPA today, Laura to return signed NDA (or mark up), then schedule a 30-min legal sync if Mike wants to walk through any Ifs/Exceptions.
